Name: Coward Lewis
Author: AsPudding
Description:
Hi ! 

This is my first mod ever, so I'm expecting that there will probably be some issues. It works well in my game, which is why I'm publishing it but it may behave differently in yours if you have a different set of mods.. Etc. 


[u]Why did I make the mod ?[/u] 

I hated that the only choices you get during this event are either keeping Lewis' secret, or being the town's gossip. I first used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7686]Marnie deserves better[/url], but as I'm using a different mod that pairs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34255]Marnie with Marlon[/url], that third option didn't fit well either for me.. SO I decided to learn to mod [i]specifically[/i] for this. And here we are. 


[u]What does the mod do ?[/u] 

[list]
[*]Edits Lewis and Marnie's 6 hearts event to add a third option, so you can tell Lewis Marnie *does* deserve better, without having them officialise their relationship. Picking that third option gives you -50 friendship with Lewis. Picking the " I'm going to tell everyone " options gives you -100. I chose to halve that because for me, telling him privately he's a coward hurts him less than thinking about the hit his reputation would take if you told everyone instead.
[size=2][b][color=#36819c]( New in 1.1 )[/color][/b][/size] Picking this option now gives +100 FP with Marnie. [*]Also adds a fourth option, in case you just want to ignore that event completely. This one doesn't add nor take away friendship points.
[*]Adds a follow up dialogue to the both of them if you picked option 3 or 4. It hints at Marnie thinking a bit more about what their relationship [i]is [/i]compared to what she actually wants to have.
[*]Changes Marnie's Friday's dialogue at the Saloon so she stops being moonstruck by Lewis. She's still drinking close to him though.. [size=1][s]( As I'm still not skilled enough to change that )[/s] Now can be changed in 1.1 ![/size]
[*][size=2]Lightly edits all of the answers with slightly different text, and more emotes[/size]
[*][size=2][b][color=#36819c]( New in 1.1 )[/color][/b] Edits Marnie's schedule so she stays home on Fridays ( configurable, default is False )[/size]
[*][size=2][b][color=#36819c]( New in 1.1 )[/color][/b] Edits Lewis' schedule so he sleeps in his own house on Fall 9 instead of getting in Marnie's bed ( configurable, default is False )[/size]
[*][size=2][b][color=#36819c]( New in 1.1 )[/color][/b] Edits Marnie's 6+ hearts dialogue on Fridays[/size]
[*][size=2][b][color=#36819c]( New in 1.1 )[/color] [/b]Adds a i18n folder, in case you want to translate the mod OR edit anyone's dialogue to your liking, now you can do it more easily ! [/size]
[/list]
[u]
If you'd like to know the text before downloading, it's all right there :[/u] 

[spoiler]
[u]Event : [/u]
Lewis : Name...You overheard everything, didn't you?

[b]Option 1 : ( +50 FP with Lewis )[/b]
Farmer : Yes... but I'll keep your secret.
Lewis : Thank you Name. I won't forget this.
Marnie : Why were you hiding there, anyway ?

[b]Option 2 : ( -100 FP with Lewis )[/b]
Farmer : Yes... And I'm going to tell everyone.
Lewis : What ?! Why would you even do that ?
Marnie : We should probably talk about this... Why were you hiding there, anyway ?
 
[b]Option 3 : ( - 50 FP with Lewis )[/b]
Farmer : Yes... And while it's none of my business, you're acting like a coward, Lewis. Marnie deserves better than this.
Lewis : Excuse me ?! How dare you, Name ?!
Marnie : Lewis.. I think we should talk about this.. In private. // Name, could you give us a moment, please ?

[b]Option 4 : ( No FP change )[/b]
Farmer : No, I just got here. I'm on my way to do some fishing !
Lewis : Oh.. Well. Don't let us keep you from your fishing ! Have a good night, Name.

[u]Follow-up dialogue :[/u]

[b]Option 3 :[/b]
Lewis : I can't believe you would say that to me. Now things with Marnie are... complicated, to say the least. // ...
Marnie : Oh, Name ! I wanted to thank you, for the other night. That meant a lot to me. It has been that way for so long that I kind of stopped questioning it.. What you said... It helped me put things in perspective. // You're a good friend, Name.

[b]Option 4 :[/b]
Lewis : Oh, Name ! How did your fishing go ? Did you catch anything nice ? // Wonderful !
Marnie : *Marnie seems deep in thought* // Oh ! Hello, Name. Sorry, I didn't see you there... I hope you're well.

[u]Edit to the Saloon dialogue :
[/u]
Marnie : The Saloon sure is packed on Friday nights !
( Replaces this canon dialogue : *Marnie doesn't seem to notice that you're there...* )

[u]Edit to Marnie's 6 heart dialogue on Friday :

[/u]Marnie : How are things on *Name of your farm* farm, Name ? // Feel free to ask me if you need anything for it !
( Replaces this canon dialogue : I wonder if Mr. Lewis gets lonely in that big house of his... // It seems so empty in there, doesn't it? )[/spoiler]


This has been tested in Stardew Valley v.1.6. It has *not* been tested in Stardew Valley Expanded.
I think it [i]should[/i] work with any mod that doesn't edit this specific event *or* the town map where it takes place, but I can't guarantee it.
The edit to the schedule probably won't work if you have mods that change where their beds are placed. However it does work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/url], as I am using it without issue.


Feel free to ask me if you want to edit something but aren't sure how !


[u]How to install :[/u]

[list]
[*]Make sure you have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=description]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]And the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download this file and unzip it in Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Launch the game using Smapi
IF you want to edit Marnie and Lewis' schedules[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] // Edit the files directly in the folder﻿
[*]Edit the Config file in game // Use the config.file in the folder and replace False with True.
[/list]

The portraits in the screenshots are from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CandiCornArt/mods]CandiCornArt[/url], and the Interface is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]DaisyNiko[/url].
